title: His father looked at him through a glass
html_source: By having a story start out the novel, Joyce is trying to symbolize the innocence and age of Stephen by using childish language like “moo cow” and “baby tuckoo”. Joyce is also trying to show that Stephen is only able to identify himself through his dad’s words since he’s still too young to locate himself in society.
